blocks.text: What could slip the demo or bite right after

items: Lead-time items can't be compressed: Developer ID signing and CMS ESRD-model acquisition both start with you and gate downstream work
Demo dollar math needs the real PY2025 ratebook (acme-labs #NNN) - the cache currently holds only the 2026 book; verify PY2025 coverage before relying on D-family numbers
The silent no-op is the trap: a blank install currently PASSes a run with zero recompute - #NNN's visible guard must land or the demo can mislead
Dependabot moderate (glib, #NNN) is open on main - low risk, but clear it inside the demo milestone
Real PHI stays out until #NNN (sidecar token) lands - synthetic corpus only for the rehearsal
